نحتوش (form VIII)
# نَحْتَوِشُ (naḥtawišu) /naħ.ta.wi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# نُحْتَوَشُ (nuḥtawašu) /nuħ.ta.wa.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# نَحْتَوِشَ (naḥtawiša) /naħ.ta.wi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# نُحْتَوَشَ (nuḥtawaša) /nuħ.ta.wa.ʃa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
